label: Excellent
description: Clears credit quickly and usually pays on or before the 7-day target.

label: Very Good
description: Usually pays within the 15-day target, with only small delays.

label: Good
description: Normally clears dues within the 30-day target.

label: Average
description: Pays eventually, but often needs more time before clearing dues.

label: Needs Attention
description: Regularly slips beyond the expected date and needs follow-up.

label: Problem
description: Frequently stays overdue and is at real risk of further downgrade.

label: Defaulter
description: Repeatedly misses payment cycles and needs urgent recovery.
